value.rationale: The exact all-odd sextic variance supplies a structurally complete fluctuation law for the same stochastic decoder-resynchronization problem whose mean Gusev computed. The cubic standard-deviation scale and limiting coefficient of variation sqrt(2/3) are genuine new distributional information not implied by an expectation. It is an all-parameter natural observable with a direct reliability interpretation, not a routine finite-table increment.
